Adding a vendor or changing the bill commitment requires both Safe owners (2-of-2). Open this treasury in Safe to propose and approve the action.

Emergency unwind requires both Safe owners (2-of-2). In Safe, propose the module emergency unwind, review the withdrawal legs, and collect both owner signatures. Guardian Stop only pauses the agent.
